name: Konata Konatsu
source:
Specialty: plant magic
Likes: housework, gardening
Dislikes: a large audience, ghosts
Height: 145.3cm
Konatsu is a kind and very shy girl who likes to get along with everyone, her dream is to become an amazing magician.
She falls in love with the protagonist at first sight and she always gets embarrassed when she's around him, she's the best friend of Kuon.
[spoiler] In her route, it is revealed that she and protagonist met in the past.
